definitions.explanation: Money set aside for future use, or the act of accumulating money over time. More formal than {貯金|ちょきん} and often used in financial and economic contexts to refer to total accumulated assets, not just bank deposits.

examples.japanese: ⟦{老後|ろうご}→老後：15131_rougo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{貯蓄|ちょちく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{毎月|まいつき}→毎月：00732_maitsuki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{貯蓄額|ちょちくがく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{増|ふ}やしたい→増やす：02410_fuyasu⟧。
examples.english: I want to increase how much I save each month.

examples.japanese: ⟦{十分|じゅうぶん}→十分：01614_juubun⟧な{貯蓄|ちょちく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{急|きゅう}→急：13042_kyuu⟧な⟦{出費|しゅっぴ}→出費：09205_shuppi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{対応|たいおう}→対応：02510_taiou⟧⟦できない→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: Without sufficient savings, you can't handle unexpected expenses.

notes: Often confused with ⟦{貯金|ちょきん}→貯金：03497_chokin⟧. While ⟦{貯金|ちょきん}→貯金：03497_chokin⟧ specifically refers to money deposited in a bank, {貯蓄|ちょちく} is broader and includes all forms of accumulated financial assets such as stocks, insurance, and property. {貯蓄|ちょちく} is more commonly used in formal, economic, and financial planning contexts. Common collocations: {貯蓄|ちょちく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{増|ふ}やす→増やす：02410_fuyasu⟧ (increase savings), {貯蓄|ちょちく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{取|と}り{崩|くず}す (dip into savings), {貯蓄率|ちょちくりつ} (savings rate).
